scripts.check:minimatch: node -e "const l=require('./package-lock.json'); const pk=l.packages||{}; const found=Object.entries(pk).filter(([k])=>k.includes('node_modules/minimatch')).map(([k,v])=>k+'@'+v.version); if(!found.length){console.error('No minimatch entries found in lockfile'); process.exit(1);} const bad=found.filter((x)=>!x.endsWith('@10.2.1')); if(bad.length){console.error('Unexpected minimatch versions:', bad.join(', ')); process.exit(1);} console.log('Verified minimatch entries:', found.join(', '));"
